scope: Native procedural source geometry/routing fixtures, not gameplay transitions or delivery. Existing held/world painted requests blocked.

cloak_protect.name: Cloak of Protection
cloak_protect.desc: Armour class +1, over whatever else you wear.

cloak_elven.name: Elven Cloak
cloak_elven.desc: Sleeping things notice you a square later.

cloak_shadow.name: Shadow-Spun Cloak
cloak_shadow.desc: Armour class +1, and sleeping things notice you a square later.

cloak_warmth.name: Cloak of Warmth
cloak_warmth.desc: Cold does half as much to you: a wraith's touch, the lich's grave-cold and its storm.

wayfarer_lantern.name: Silver Lantern
wayfarer_lantern.desc: The last flame from the other side, carried in worn silver. A focus for the Wayfarer alone. Deepward: +1 armour class from floor 9, another every two floors, up to +4 while held.

spellbook.name: Spellbook
spellbook.desc: Spell points come back a quarter faster as you walk.

crystal_orb.name: Crystal Orb
crystal_orb.desc: One more damage on each of a spell's dice, up to two.

orb_storms.name: Orb of Storms
orb_storms.desc: Lightning Bolt and Cone of Cold strike a fifth harder and hold what they hit back a moment longer.

holy_symbol.name: Holy Symbol
holy_symbol.desc: Your healing spells heal a quarter more.

silver_symbol.name: Silver Sunburst
silver_symbol.desc: Holy Smite and Flame Strike strike a quarter harder.

reliquary.name: Reliquary
reliquary.desc: Your healing spells heal a quarter more, and Holy Smite and Flame Strike strike a quarter harder.

potion_might.name: Potion of Might
potion_might.desc: +2 to hit and damage for two minutes.

scroll_fire.name: Scroll of Fire
scroll_fire.desc: Hurls a ball of fire (4d6) at the foe ahead. With none, it bursts where it lands, and sets spilt oil alight.

scroll_frost.name: Scroll of Frost
scroll_frost.desc: A cone of cold (3d6) over everything up to three squares ahead, holding each back a moment; water round them freezes.

scroll_lightning.name: Scroll of Lightning
scroll_lightning.desc: A bolt of lightning (3d6) through everything up to three squares ahead, and through water to all standing in it.

scroll_map.name: Scroll of Mapping
scroll_map.desc: Reveals the layout of this floor.

scroll_teleport.name: Scroll of Teleport
scroll_teleport.desc: Whisks you to a random spot on this floor.

satchel.name: Lampfolk Satchel
satchel.desc: Lost by one of the Lampfolk. The next trader you meet will pay for its return.

quench.name: Smiths' Quench
quench.desc: A stone flask of black water, cold as the deep. Poured on the Heart of the Mountain, it puts the fire out for good.

charm_collar.name: Iron-Studded Collar
charm_collar.desc: For your companion to wear: blows find it harder to land (+3 armour).

charm_fang.name: Fang Charm
charm_fang.desc: For your companion to wear: its every blow deals 2 more.

charm_rowan.name: Rowan Knot
charm_rowan.desc: For your companion to wear: its wounds close by themselves, a hit point every four seconds.

charm_whetstone.name: Sellsword's Whetstone
charm_whetstone.desc: For a sellsword to wear: their every cut deals 3 more. A hound, a wolf or a goblin has no use for it.

lamp_oil.name: Flask of Lamp Oil
lamp_oil.desc: Throw it: it smashes up to three squares ahead, or on the first thing in the way, and spills lamp oil there. Any fire sets the oil alight.

oil_fire.name: Fire Oil
oil_fire.desc: Coats your weapon: its next 20 blows that land burn for 1d4 more, and no troll mends the wound.

oil_silver.name: Silver Wash
oil_silver.desc: Coats your weapon: its next 20 blows that land deal 1d6 more to the undead.

oil_venom.name: Blade Venom
oil_venom.desc: Coats your weapon: for its next 20 blows that land, one in three poisons the living.

oil_frost.name: Frost Oil
oil_frost.desc: Coats your weapon: its next 20 blows that land chill for 1d4 more and hold the foe back a moment, and water round it freezes.

scroll_uncurse.name: Scroll of Remove Curse
scroll_uncurse.desc: Breaks any curse on what you wear, and shows the true quality of all your gear.

ring_protect.name: Ring of Protection
ring_protect.desc: Armour class +1, more if finely made.

ring_might.name: Ring of Might
ring_might.desc: +1 to hit and to damage with every blow, more if finely made.

ring_evasion.name: Ring of Evasion
ring_evasion.desc: +2 to every saving throw: venom, traps, and the tricks that land.

ring_seer.name: Ring of the Seer
ring_seer.desc: +6 to spot a trap before it springs, and the Seer sees hidden doors as you pass.

ring_mend.name: Ring of Regeneration
ring_mend.desc: Heals a hit point every four seconds, even mid-fight.

ring_quiet.name: Ring of Stealth
ring_quiet.desc: Sleeping monsters notice you a square later.

ring_warmth.name: Ring of Warmth
ring_warmth.desc: Cold does half as much to you: a wraith's touch, the lich's grave-cold and its storm.

ring_gallows.name: Gallows Ring
ring_gallows.desc: +3 to hit and to damage with every blow. It is cursed: once on, it will not come off until the curse is broken, and while it is worn your wounds do not close by themselves, nor with rest.

ring_forge.name: Forge Ring
ring_forge.desc: +1 to hit and to damage with every blow, more if finely made.

amulet_life.name: Amulet of Life Saving
amulet_life.desc: The blow that would kill you does not: you are left standing at half your life, and the amulet crumbles to dust.

amulet_ward.name: Amulet of Warding
amulet_ward.desc: Your life force cannot be drained, and poison cannot take hold of you.

amulet_mind.name: Amulet of Wizardry
amulet_mind.desc: +6 spell points for anyone who has spells to spend them on.

amulet_tooth.name: Tooth Charm
amulet_tooth.desc: Heals a hit point every four seconds, even mid-fight.

key.name: Key
key.desc: Opens one locked door of matching colour on this floor.

page.name: Torn Page
page.desc: Something one of the earlier crews left behind.

artifact.name: The Heart of the Mountain
artifact.desc: The treasure you came for. Its light is warm in your hands.
